notes.title: Resolution Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug introduced in the last update where graphics & resolution options no longer took effect.

notes.title: Accessibility/Colorblind Update
notes.notes:
The Following Options have been added to the video settings menu:

Colorblind Options

 None -Enabled by Default
 Protanopia - Simulates missing red cones.
 Protanomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity red cones.
 Deuteranopia - Simulates missing green cones.
 Deuteranomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity green cones.
 Tritanopia - Simulates missing blue cones.
 Tritanomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity blue cones.
 Achromatopsia - Simulates completely missing cones.
 Achromatomaly - Simulates reduced sensitivity of all cones



Please note that this only impacts the gameplay camera and not the U.I.


Cheers!

notes.title: User Feedback & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
General Improvements

 Modified font for easier readability.
 NPC Dialogue is now slightly faster.
 Added additional Video Settings options to the main menu.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where the gem locator arrow would not automatically appear when re-entering a level.
 When playing a minigame in Rapid Ryan's Arcade and returning to the main game, it would cause the game to misbehave. These issues have since been resolved.

notes.title: Pinball Panic Update!
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Vibration/Rumble support has been added for gamepads.

Accessibility Options:

Bug Fixes:

Happy Gaming!

*These songs are brand new to the game and I hope you will enjoy them!

notes.title: Visual update / Patch # 4
notes.notes:
2 different sets of horns have been added to the overworld, happy hunting!


 Power-boxes now emit sparks
 Fire-hydrants now spray water
 Bushes shoot out leaves when touched


5-sided Orange Gems have been changed into 4-sided Teal Gems.

 This change was made to help differentiate them between the 8-sided Red Gems.

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in the climbing animation in very rare circumstances.
 Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in the hopping animation when landing on a parked vehicle.
 Overworld: Fixed an issue where the Wich Trials would remain open upon re-entering the pause menu.
 Charming Chopper: Out of Bounds issue after beating the chopper.
 Magical Meadows: Out of Bounds issue regarding the fox patrol.
 Mushroom Marsh: Fixed an exploit where the player could bypass the hedgemaze.
 Paradise Park: Fixed an exploit where the player could bypass the hedgemaze.
 Snakes, Ladders & Chutes: Fixed an issue where the Gem Locator wouldn't trigger.
 Graceful Games: Fixed a typo associated with Nagging Nikky.
 Great Gamble: Fixed an exploit where the player could bypass the end maze.
 Devious Donna: Fixed an issue where players could bypass the poison snake corridor.
 Simmering Sports: Widened the width of the Horse Jumps in the race against Rapid Ryan.

notes.title: Feature Update / Patch #2
notes.notes:
Features:

 New gem finder is automatically turned on when there are 5 or fewer gems left to collect in a level!
 New Library Icon
 Minimum and maximum sensitivity options for the camera have been increased in both x & y axes.



Bug Fixes:

 Cauldron Ball: Fixed an issue where the timer counts down at double speed.
 Charming Chopper: Fixed Audio Bugs
 Frozen Forest: Fixed bug which caused stumps to glow red


Fixed sound effects levels not properly scaling on the following:

 Charming Chopper missiles
 Wild Willy howling
 Bowling on Manic Machines


Solemn Swamps:

 Adjusted Swamp Land incorrectly killing Roxy nearing the end of the level.
 Log hitboxes radius on decreased in size.

notes.notes:
